paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: : Loss Ratio FLOPs
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the Loss Ratio as a function of TFLOPs for several models. The x-axis is labeled "TFLOPs" and uses a linear scale ranging from 1e7 to 9e8 with tick labels at increments of 1e7. The y-axis is labeled "Loss Ratio (%)" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 94 to 100. A purple solid line with triangular markers represents "Vanilla," starting at approximately 96.9% at 1e7 TFLOPs and reaching a maximum of 99.2% at 5e8 TFLOPs before declining to 98.8% at 9e8 TFLOPs. An orange solid line with circular markers represents "SepLLM (n=64)," beginning at approximately 96.3% at 1e7 TFLOPs and increasing to a peak of 99.3% at 3e8 TFLOPs before decreasing to 98.6% at 9e8 TFLOPs. A blue solid line with x markers represents "SepLLM (n=128)," starting at approximately 97.1% at 1e7 TFLOPs and rising to a maximum of 99.3% at 5e8 TFLOPs, then decreasing to 98.9% at 9e8 TFLOPs. A green solid line with downward-pointing triangle markers represents "SepLLM (n=64, H)," commencing at approximately 96.7% at 1e7 TFLOPs, increasing to approximately 99.2% at 3e8 TFLOPs, and subsequently decreasing to 98.7% at 9e8 TFLOPs. A red solid line with diamond markers represents "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)," beginning at approximately 94.8% at 1e7 TFLOPs, climbing to a peak of 99.2% at 3e8 TFLOPs, and ultimately decreasing to 98.4% at 9e8 TFLOPs.
